note: A building in a world stream or save: i32 chunk length, u8 version(), writeBase, then write() of the building class chain (each override calls super.write first). Block snapshots use writeSync, which is writeAll unless overridden. 'declares' lists the serialization methods a class itself overrides. write ops are recovered from hand-written bytecode: 'loop' and 'if' mark repeated and conditional writes; Golden.building() gives exact bytes.
